content: Set against the backdrop of the strike at various units of Simpson & Company Limited in Madras, the novel by Balakumaran chronicles one of the longest labour agitations in Tamil Nadu.

title: How Tamil actor M.R. Radha got away with staging a ‘banned’ play in 1959
content: The Madras Government, in April 1959, banned popular actor M.R. Radha’s Tamil play Thooku Medai. He submitted the script of another drama Kathal Bali to the Madras Commissioner of Police and obtained a licence to perform it. On noticing that the play was similar to the banned Thooku Medai, the police registered a case.

title: Mohan Bhagwat warns against agitations that divide, urges unity rooted in ‘Hindu spirit’
content: When a protest becomes a political instrument driven by hostility towards a person, group or ideology, forces seeking to keep India subdued take advantage of the situation, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh’s head says

title: Tiger Shroff shooting case: Police lens on Lawrence's US-based aide Randeep Malik
content: Anil Pandit Pandit and Shroff ’s shooter Rehan both reported to Malik and were considered “his men” till a few months ago, a source said. Rehan had been earlier tasked by Malik and Pandit with a shooting incident in Sonipat as well. “Rehan was shown the same ‘American dream’ that Malik had shown Pandit in the past,” a source said.

title: Musk ordered Starlink slowdown, kept Ukraine and Trump administration in dark
content: US officials, however, have denied ordering any slowdown. Defence secretary Pete Hegseth said Washington had not directed any reduction in the satellite services, while secretary of state Marco Rubio maintained that the White House was not responsible for the reported disruption. Speaking to reporters, Hegseth said the US military had not instructed any changes to the satellite service used by Ukraine.

title: Identify, defeat forces against India: Modi calls for unity, self-reliance
content: PM urges parties, institutions to put nation first; says national self-respect and strength key to overcoming challenges

title: Dale Steyn’s 18-year-old record falls as Harmer scripts history against Australia
content: Simon Harmer made headlines with an impressive 82 in the second Test against Australia, eclipsing the previous record of 76 runs held by Dale Steyn for South African No. 9 batsmen. His performance was vital in rescuing South Africa from a challenging position of 110-6. Partnering with Temba Bavuma, their formidable eighth-wicket alliance totaled 183 runs. South Africa eventually declared at 425-9, while Australia wrapped up Day 3 at 3-1.

title: Oil prices today: Brent crude tops $110 as Middle East tensions threaten shipments
content: Oil prices have risen due to growing concerns over disruptions in Middle East supplies and threats to shipping routes. Recent attacks on vessels and infrastructure have heightened worries among traders and analysts. While Brent crude futures climbed to $110.10, WTI crude also saw an increase following previous declines. US officials are working with refiners to address rising fuel prices and shortages.

title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
content: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.

title: In talks with Reliance to refine more Venezuelan oil: Marco Rubio
content: US secretary of state Marco Rubio is visiting Jamnagar Wednesday to tour the Reliance refinery and, in a lastminute change of schedule, is likely to spend the night there. He was earlier scheduled to leave around 9pm and return to Mumbai. In Jamnagar, he will have dinner with Mukesh Ambani at the Vantara centre. Rubio’s visit to Jamnagar comes within weeks of a vicious attack on Ambani by Elon Musk.

title: 'Russia a big machine': Trump says Ukraine 'has to want' to settle war with Putin
content: US president Trump pointed to Russia's ability to sustain its military campaign and capture territory, portraying Moscow as having the upper hand in the conflict. "Russia is a big machine - they just keep grinding forward, and that's what they've done. They've taken a very large piece of land," he said.

title: 5-year-old with neurological condition walks 30 laps for 30 days, raises $100K
content: Gregor Corse, a five-year-old boy from Scotland with an undiagnosed neurological condition, has raised over $100,000 for Inclusive Orkney by walking 30 laps around his house daily for 30 days. His inspiring determination earned him the Youngest Fundraiser of the Year title at the 2026 Pride of Britain Awards. He now hopes to raise more money.

title: Florida homeowners denied legal fees after $157K Ian repair dispute
content: In a recent decision, a Florida appeals court determined that homeowners Susan Reed and Kent Lonngren are ineligible to collect legal fees from Citizens Property Insurance. The couple had contested repairs linked to Hurricane Ian's 2022 storm damage. The court concluded that Citizens had fulfilled its duties, even while the homeowners pursued legal action during the appraisal phase, indicating that Citizens acted in good faith throughout the claim.

title: US govt bans American tech firm from Green Card programme for 2 yrs; fines $1.4 mn
content: Cloudera, a data management company, has been banned from the Permanent Labor Certification program for two years. This decision follows allegations of discrimination against qualified U.S. workers during its recruitment process. A fine of $1.4 million will be imposed to resolve the case and compensate affected workers. Additionally, the company will face compliance obligations to uphold federal labor laws. This settlement highlights ongoing efforts to protect U.S.

title: Delhi HR pro quits corporate job for Goa, faces financial uncertainty
content: After leaving her stable job in HR, Arpita Sahu embraced a new beginning in Goa, sharing her heartfelt journey on social media. As she expressed her concerns about financial security and belonging, her followers responded with a range of insights on fulfillment. Sahu's experience captures the complexities of navigating life changes, revealing the emotional weight of pursuing one’s dreams while facing an uncertain future.

title: 'Darlings' actor Divya Vinekar passes away
content: Divya Vinekar's sudden departure was revealed by RJ Rohini Ramnathan via social media, marking an emotional moment for many. Requesting privacy for the grieving family, Ramnathan provided details for the cremation for those eager to honor Vinekar's memory. She graced screens with memorable performances in 'Darlings' and 'Jalsa', known for her professionalism and kindness, and her legacy continues to resonate within the film community.

title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a 'good idea', special committees formed for talks
content: SpaceX shares rose 4.9% in extended trading following the remarks. Speculation about a potential deal has grown in recent weeks, with Barclays suggesting last week that an announcement could come before Tesla's annual meeting in December. Musk has previously floated the idea, pointing to increasing overlap between the businesses. The merger discussions came as SpaceX reported its first profit as a public company.

title: Hacker group claims access to 3.8 lakh SBI data entries
content: The claim was highlighted by cybersecurity monitoring account CyberPulse56 in a post on social media platform X. According to the account, the group purportedly possesses about 3.8 lakh data entries in CSV format and 2,722 pdf documents associated with the country’s largest public sector lender. The allegedly exposed dataset is said to contain customers’ personal information, residential addresses, loan applications, supporting documents and other applicationrelated records.

title: Former NBA All-Star Amar'e Stoudemire joins police academy in Florida
content: Amar’e Stoudemire has officially completed his training at the Basic Law Enforcement Academy and is ready to embark on a new chapter with the Miami-Dade Schools Police Department. Inspired by his family's legacy in law enforcement, Stoudemire, who retired from the NBA in 2016, also explored international basketball while establishing his own wine brand.

title: NBA commissioner Adam Silver responds to LeBron James' Fanatics helicopter deal
content: LeBron James has adopted a helicopter for his daily commute to the Philadelphia 76ers from New York City, a move confirmed by NBA commissioner Adam Silver as compliant with league regulations. This travel arrangement is a result of James' collaboration with Fanatics, structured to adhere to NBA rules, ensuring no impact on salary cap terms. Speculation around this perk links to the ties between James and the owner of Fanatics.

title: Allahabad HC cites long trial, lets off offenders, SC slams ‘misplaced sympathy’
content: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran said it was a case of misplaced sympathy. The trial court had awarded fiveyear jail terms to the two, but the HC released them on probation. SC said the case was “doomed from its inception insofar as justice delivery to the victim is concerned”.

title: 2 British Indians assaulted during Dussehra, Bathukamma celebrations
content: The assaults happened on Oct 17 outside Ossett Town Hall, which was hosting the celebration. The event was organised by local Telugu Hindu community groups. Earlier in the evening a group of around 25 local white youths, mostly male, were cycling around on e-bikes asking organisers what was going on in the town hall and who was inside.

title: Desi Bela Bajaria leaves Netflix after giving global blockbusters
content: Bela Bajaria has stepped down from her role as chief content officer at Netflix amid significant challenges in the media landscape. She oversaw an impressive annual budget of almost $20 billion while bolstering Netflix's international content strategy. With a decline in audience engagement highlighting the industry's evolution, the streaming giant is poised for a transformative approach. Peter Rice, formerly of Disney and Fox, is set to take the helm.

title: Delhi HC cites national security, junks CIC order to IAF on PMs’ foreign trips
content: Allowing a petition by the Central Public Information Officer of Directorate of Personal Services, Air Headquarters, Justice Amit Mahajan held the IAF was justified in denying access to the records under section 8 of RTI that exempts disclosure of information that could jeopardise national security or pose a risk to a person’s life and physical safety.

title: Smartphone shipments slip, Chinese brands lose ground
content: Vivo’s shipments dropped 34% to 6.4 million — the sharpest decline among the top five. Repeated price increases disrupted retailers’ inventory planning, while limited supplies of entry-level phones weakened its position. Xiaomi’s traditional appeal of offering more features for the money also came under pressure. Rising component costs forced trade-offs on pricing and memory configurations, with shipments falling 28% to 4.7 million.

title: Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman warns of unrest bid by ‘2 united parties’
content: PM said attempts were made to create labour unrest at some factories in different parts of the country, adding that intelligence reports indicated that the ousted authoritarian regime was supplying money for such activities. “There is a party also here that spreads rumours in the country. The party tried to sell various tickets to the people before the election by telling lies. These two parties have now united,” he said.

title: India, US ‘perfectly aligned’ on key issues: Rubio; defends ties with Pakistan
content: Addressing a gathering of India Inc’s leading business figures, Rubio said the relationship between the two countries could help shape the future of the global economy, particularly as advances in artificial intelligence and quantum computing transform industries and societies. “I truly believe the relationship between US and India is defining, in many ways, in a positive way, what the 21st century can look like,” he said.

title: India & US to boost defence, energy ties, Marco Rubio says trade deal close
content: Rubio’s second visit to India comes against the backdrop of the US’s Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which is intended to penalise countries purchasing Russian oil, and Trump’s subsequent temporary suspension of related tariffs. India maintains that its oil procurement is essential not only for its own energy security but also for the stability of global markets. Rubio lauded the “substantial progress” made by India in diversifying its energy portfolio.

title: No double standards on terror, need unified action to dismantle its entire ecosystem: Rajnath at SCO; says members will have to work together on resilient supply chains
content: During the SCO meeting in Dushanbe, Rajnath Singh emphasised the need for collective efforts against terrorism. He stated that terrorism undermines investments while calling for an end to double standards. Furthermore, he discussed India's initiatives to enhance connectivity and trade with Central Asia for mutual development. Rajnath highlighted India's significant contribution to global economic growth amidst a worldwide slowdown.

title: Harry Warner's Beverly Hills mansion listed for nearly $40m, sold for $27.25m
content: A legendary mansion in Beverly Hills, originally built for Harry Warner, has changed hands for $27.25 million after an extended listing. Initially priced at nearly $40 million in 2016, the estate received extensive upgrades while maintaining its Old Hollywood charm. Featuring a guesthouse linked to Marilyn Monroe, this property has hosted myriad celebrations.

title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Delhi Police arrests 4 accused, including 2 women
content: In a significant breakthrough, the Delhi Police Special Cell has detained four suspects—Kunal, Sumit, Radha, and Babita—as part of an ongoing probe. These individuals have been transferred to the Mumbai Police, who are seeking a transit remand to delve deeper into a shooting incident linked to actor Tiger Shroff's vehicle. Previously, three other suspects were arrested in Rajasthan and have since been brought to Mumbai for interrogation.

title: Trump’s tariff waiver on Russian oil: India gets relief for now, but is it credible?
content: For India, the immediate relief is for its crude supply basket and exporters. If India decided to give up Russian crude oil, its single largest supplier would have gone off the table, with no easy replacement amid Middle East tensions. If it continued to buy Russian crude, then the 100% tariffs would have weighed on its exports to the US.

title: Delhi BJP leader burns cockroach effigy; Dipke responds with SRK’s 'Swades' song
content: During Dussehra celebrations in Delhi, a 30-foot cockroach effigy was burned alongside traditional effigies of Ravan. Organizers stated that the effigy symbolized filth and promoted cleanliness in line with health awareness initiatives. Leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party reacted sharply, suggesting the move provided them with free publicity. Delhi minister Kapil Mishra remarked that cockroaches symbolize chaos and filth, reflecting public sentiment.

title: Harmanpreet Kaur’s 91 powers India to 3-0 T20I series sweep against Zimbabwe
content: India's women's cricket team displayed sheer dominance against Zimbabwe, clinching the third T20I by a commanding 92 runs. With Shafali Verma and Harmanpreet Kaur leading the charge, scoring 69 and 91 respectively, Zimbabwe struggled in the chase, ending at 124/7 after facing early setbacks. Nandani Sharma's stellar three-wicket performance solidified the win, marking an impressive 11-match T20I winning streak.

title: 'Enough drama': Prince Harry says he wants to reconcile with family after years of rift
content: Prince Harry recently opened up about the need for reconciliation with his family, sharing his personal experiences that resonate with many who struggle with familial conflicts. He conveyed his aspirations for nurturing better connections with his father, King Charles III, and brother, Prince William. Harry also reflected on the joyous moments of his children attending a British school, honoring his mother's legacy and embracing a new chapter of healing.

title: California's 750-acre Irvine Lake to be drained for five-year dam repairs
content: This month, Irvine Lake will see a significant decrease in water levels as vital dam repairs begin. The planned drawdown will facilitate crucial construction activities, enhancing the dam's structural integrity as per regulatory requirements. Water managers are closely monitoring potential winter weather effects to ensure community safety, while conversations with environmental specialists are underway to safely relocate fish and address concerns from anglers.

title: AAP demands FIR over 30ft cockroach effigy burned alongside Ravan in Delhi
content: AAP Delhi president Saurabh Bharadwaj lodged a complaint against the Shri Keshav Ramlila Committee for burning a cockroach effigy. He claimed the act hurt religious sentiments and demanded the registration of an FIR against the organisers. Delhi minister Kapil Mishra, who attended the event, responded sarcastically to the complaint. The effigy was burned alongside traditional figures of Ravan, Kumbhakaran, and Meghnad during the event.

title: 'Where are the fans?' Warner calls out lack of fans at South Africa-Australia Tests
content: David Warner is voicing alarm over the dismal attendance during the ongoing Test series between South Africa and Australia. Both teams hold the top two positions in Test cricket rankings, yet crowds have been sparse. Rain has exacerbated the situation, resulting in noticeably empty stands. With the echoes of the 2018 ball-tampering scandal lingering, this series' low turnout raises critical questions about the future of Test cricket's allure.

title: Memo from New Delhi: Make America India Again?
content: Donald Trump proposed renaming New Mexico to New America, claiming it would enhance pride among residents and change election integrity. Political representatives from New Mexico opposed the idea, emphasizing the state's historical significance and established name. Constitutional barriers exist, as name changes require formal processes involving local and national laws. Historical context surrounding America’s naming is complex and reflects a mix of cultural influences.

title: Tiger Shroff wasn’t original target, shooters switched due to tight security: Cops
content: Mumbai Crime Branch revealed Tiger Shroff was not the shooters' intended target as they aimed for another celebrity. Due to tight security around the intended target, the shooters shifted focus to Shroff instead. The suspects were arrested in Rajasthan's Kota and granted a 48-hour transit remand for transport to Mumbai. Following the remand, the Mumbai Police adopted an alternative strategy for the safety of the accused.

title: 'Disregards consensus': China slams US for after DeepSeek ban from govt IT systems
content: China has strongly criticized the US for its recent ban on the DeepSeek AI model, claiming it undermines the interests of Chinese enterprises. The Chinese commerce ministry pointed out that the US Department of Homeland Security's concerns regarding security threats from DeepSeek products are unfounded. China warns against the politicization of technology and national security concerns, suggesting that this development could further strain economic relations between the two superpowers.

title: 'Youth on streets are revolutionaries': Uddhav Thackeray calls for 'regime change'
content: During the vibrant Dussehra rally at Shivaji Park in Mumbai, Uddhav Thackeray rallied his supporters, highlighting the significance of youth activism in addressing the alleged electoral irregularities impacting the fresh electorate. He proclaimed that the saffron identity is a legacy of his party, urging a reformation in the political climate and the prominent display of the saffron flag, echoing the influence of Bal Thackeray in his passionate address.

title: Kerala man gets Rs 54,500 payout after cruise cancelled without notice
content: A family's dream cruise was abruptly canceled without warning, leaving them in distress. The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in Kerala found both the holiday company and cruise operator at fault. Despite repeated attempts to secure a refund after the cancellation, the complainant was denied compensation. The commission mandated a refund along with additional compensation for the trouble caused, allowing one month for compliance before penalties escalate.

title: Why India slipped in Asian Games standings despite 24 medals as China extend lead
content: India achieved 24 medals, achieving five golds on Day 2 of the Asian Para Games 2026. Nishad Kumar and Deepthi Jeevanji led the country with outstanding athletic performances, contributing significantly to the medal tally. Despite this notable success, India's ranking dropped from fourth to sixth due to the gold medal count. China continued to lead the standings with a significant gap over competing nations.
